items.title: F5 (FFIV) Stock May Be 10% Undervalued As AI Security Demand Builds
items.summary: F5 has seen its share price climb over recent years, even as the last month brought a sharp pullback, which puts fresh attention on whether the current valuation lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With investors weighing AI-driven security demand, multi cloud spending and heavier investment, the question is how much of F5's future cash flows are already reflected in today's price. items.title: Oversold AI and chip stocks after the Nasdaq’s worst day since 2020
items.summary: Investing.com -- Thursday’s selloff hit technology stocks hard. The Nasdaq 100 fell 6.4%, its worst day since 2020. The S&P 500 lost 4.4%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped more than 12%. The trigger was Democratic midterm wins in key data-center states, which stoked fears of tougher AI regulation and a slower data-center buildout. Jefferies called it "reactionary, not a fundamental reset" (Nov 6, 2026).
